summary: This note introduces Skyward Solutions' Chronic Disease Management and Prevention Program, which supports employees living with conditions like diabetes, heart disease and respiratory illness and promotes prevention. It combines employee testimonials with lists of preventive measures and management supports. The company also gathers employee feedback through surveys and interviews and has acted on it, for example by starting a monthly health newsletter.
one_line: Skyward Solutions' policy on preventing and managing chronic disease among employees, with testimonials, program offerings and a feedback loop.
key_facts: Skyward Solutions has a Chronic Disease Management and Prevention Program for employees managing chronic conditions and for preventing their onset.
The chronic diseases named include diabetes, heart disease, and respiratory conditions.
John, an engineer with type 2 diabetes, said nutritional counseling and regular on-site health screenings made him feel "more in control of my condition."
Mary, who has a history of cardiac issues, said the company's fitness subsidies and stress management workshops have been "game changers" for her.
Preventive measures include free annual health screenings, educational resources on chronic disease prevention, exercise and healthy eating programs, and vaccination clinics.

The Chronic Disease Management Program offers support groups, personalized healthcare plans that integrate with job responsibilities, easy access to medication and medical equipment, and flexible working arrangements for medical appointments.
Jennifer, a member of the client services team with chronic asthma, said flexible scheduling around treatments and her team's understanding made "all the difference."
Skyward Solutions collects employee input through surveys and one-on-one interviews and adjusts its programs accordingly.
Mike, from the Skyward Solutions IT department, suggested more frequent health updates and tips.
Following Mike's feedback, the company started a monthly health newsletter.
Skyward Solutions treats prevention as the first line of defense against chronic diseases and offers regular health education sessions.
The company's stated goal is a healthy, productive workforce through education, prevention, and management.
